company.name: iStoria
company.shortDescription: iStoria specializes edtech app that helps people improve their english language through reading interesting stories.
company.description: iStoria is an English learning app that uses a graded reader strategy to encourage users to keep learning. It helps learners in gaining over 400 English words per month and making their learning journey in order to master english professionally in less than 6 months. They use academic and certified learning strategies and smart alerts to track your progress.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application that helps users improve their English language skills through reading graded Oxford stories, listening, and interactive vocabulary exercises.
productsAndServices.name: iStoria English Learning App

productsAndServices.description: An assessment tool within the app that evaluates users' English proficiency to place them at the appropriate learning level.
productsAndServices.name: Level Placement Test

productsAndServices.description: An interactive system that helps users learn and master English vocabulary through flashcards, quizzes, and spaced repetition.
productsAndServices.name: Vocabulary Learning System

productsAndServices.description: A subscription option allowing up to six family members to access iStoria's learning content with individual accounts under one plan.
productsAndServices.name: Family Subscription Plan

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,300,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,433,311 to $8,807,408, a 2.57x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 46 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Duolingo, busuu, Babbel.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
